references.qualification: The0.5–15m interval describes sampled depths assigned to the river-influenced WACC water group using temperature, salinity and dissolved oxygen. It is not a continuous directly measured velocity layer, a0.5m physical top or15m detected flow bottom, a14.5m thickness, uncertainty or seasonal range. Separate Shelf15–26m, offshore upper-layer and dense NAdDW/ADW waters must not be inherited into the named coastal-current depth. The deeper cascading event motivates the study but does not make WACC a bottom current. No assignment to the2018 publication year or separate model initialization dates.

references.qualification: Figure-presence inference only: read the observed ADCP mean vector, not the standard-deviation ellipse or the blue model set. No arrow-length velocity digitization, speed threshold, significance test, detected terminal boundary or deepest-flow claim. Figure negative vertical-coordinate labels are read as positive depth below the surface.56m is station water depth, not a measured current bottom. A1/A2 channel exchanges and A7–A9 Kvarner circulation are distinct cases. Source model underestimates speeds and is not the basis of this observed bound. Two-month mean does not establish continuous instantaneous reach, seasonal extrema or a route-wide profile.
